speaker: Doctor

That is concerning advice; Iron deficiency anemia does not cause high fever, so we must investigate the infectious causes further. Have you noticed any muscle aches, dark urine, or redness in your eyes or skin? Also, did you consume any unpasteurized dairy products besides the ice cream?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Q Fever (Coxiella burnetii infection)

The normal blood results help rule out severe bacterial sepsis and typical viral causes, but your specific history of ice cream consumption (a common vehicle for unpasteurized dairy) combined with fever, headache, and anorexia during pregnancy strongly points to Q fever. I need to confirm this with a specific serology test.
